articles.image_caption: Tarik Skubal pitching for the Detroit Tigers during a 2025 game against the Los Angeles Angels. The two-time AL Cy Young winner is the most sought-after player on the 2026 MLB trade market.
articles.nri_angle: MLB trade deadline coverage for global sports fans among the Indian diaspora
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NBA 2K27 Names Wembanyama, Caitlin Clark, and Derrick Rose as Cover Athletes
articles.excerpt: 2K's latest basketball game launches September 4 with three editions, each headlined by a different star. Caitlin Clark becomes the first WNBA player featured on her own global NBA 2K cover.
articles.image_caption: Victor Wembanyama during a San Antonio Spurs game in 2024. The 22-year-old French center was named the Standard Edition cover athlete for NBA 2K27.
articles.nri_angle: NBA 2K is one of the world's best-selling sports franchises with a massive global player base, including growing basketball fandom among the Indian diaspora. The game's expansion to Nintendo Switch 2 and continued WNBA integration broadens its reach.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kansas City Chiefs Unveil $3 Billion Domed Stadium Set to Open in Kansas by 2031
articles.excerpt: The franchise released first renderings of a 70,000-seat enclosed venue in Wyandotte County, designed to preserve Arrowhead's legacy while bidding for Super Bowls and other major events.
articles.image_caption: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, the Kansas City Chiefs' home since 1972. The franchise unveiled renderings of a $3 billion domed replacement in Kansas on Wednesday, with a planned 2031 opening.
articles.nri_angle: The Chiefs' new stadium underscores the growing scale of NFL franchise investments, relevant to Indian-American professionals in Kansas City's expanding tech and business corridor and the broader diaspora sports audience.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Phil Foden Signs Four-Year Contract Extension With Manchester City Until 2030
articles.excerpt: The academy graduate commits his future to his boyhood club under new manager Enzo Maresca, ending months of transfer speculation.
articles.image_caption: Phil Foden in action during a UEFA Champions League match. The Manchester City midfielder has signed a new contract keeping him at the club until 2030.
articles.nri_angle: The Premier League remains one of the most-watched sporting leagues across India and the Indian diaspora, with Foden's renewal shaping City's post-Guardiola era.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Singapore's Temasek Eyes IPL Franchise Stakes as Global Investor Rush Intensifies
articles.excerpt: The sovereign wealth fund's managing director confirmed Temasek's interest in the Indian Premier League for the first time, as two franchise sales this year valued teams at over $1.6 billion each.
articles.image_caption: The Indian Premier League. Singapore's Temasek is exploring stakes in IPL franchises as global investor interest intensifies.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American entrepreneurs and global institutional investors are increasingly reshaping IPL franchise ownership, with diaspora figures like Kal Somani leading billion-dollar acquisitions from the United States.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ibrahimovic Slams Paredes Over World Cup Final Brawl as FIFA Opens Investigation
articles.excerpt: Former Sweden striker says he would have 'headbutted' the Argentine midfielder, while FIFA appoints a prosecutor to probe the ugly post-match scenes at MetLife Stadium.
articles.image_caption: Zlatan Ibrahimovic during a public appearance. The former Sweden striker condemned Leandro Paredes' behavior after the 2026 World Cup final while working as a Fox Sports pundit.
articles.nri_angle: The 2026 World Cup final drew massive viewership among Indian football fans worldwide, with the post-match controversy sparking debate across social media.

articles.title: Rohit Sharma's Lord's Century Reshuffles ICC ODI Rankings Battle
articles.excerpt: The veteran opener's record-breaking 138 at Lord's narrows the gap with Virat Kohli in the ICC batting rankings, while Shubman Gill continues to chase New Zealand's Daryl Mitchell for the No. 1 spot.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / Cricmaze
articles.nri_angle: Three Indian batters occupy the top four spots in ODI rankings, reflecting India's batting dominance as Rohit and Kohli prepare for what could be their final World Cup.

articles.title: India Banks on Boxing, Athletics, and Weightlifting to Extend Top-Five Commonwealth Games Run
articles.excerpt: With the 2026 CWG fast approaching, India's medal strategy hinges on its traditional strongholds while emerging sports like athletics could deliver breakthrough performances.
articles.image_caption: Indian boxer Nikhat Zareen. India is counting on boxing, athletics, and weightlifting to secure a top-five finish at the Commonwealth Games.
articles.nri_angle: The Commonwealth Games are followed closely by the Indian diaspora in the UK, Canada, and Australia — nations that both host and compete against India, adding personal investment to the sporting rivalry.
